blurb: Stash 19.0 is the July 2020 release of Morgan Houppin's C UCI chess engine, introducing staged move selection, butterfly history ordering, weighted king-zone attack evaluation, and rook-on-open-file patterns atop its PVS, NMP, razoring, futility pruning, and endgame framework. Adapted to UCI over WASI on the poll helper.
fidelityNotes: Single-threaded plain wasm32-wasip1 build using the C poll helper; Hash capped for 32-bit memory. Native bench uses a fixed 1 ms thread-startup wait, so comparison uses positions.

features.label: Magic Bitboards
features.implementation: 64-bit magic bitboards for bishop and rook attack lookups.

features.label: PVS
features.implementation: Iterative deepening PVS with transposition-table cutoffs in main search and quiescence search.

features.label: Null Move Pruning
features.implementation: Dynamic null-move pruning with zugzwang verification search.

features.label: Late Move Reductions
features.implementation: Square-root reductions indexed by depth plus move count with full-depth re-search on fail-high.

features.label: Razoring & Futility
features.implementation: Razoring and futility pruning at shallow non-PV depths.

features.label: Staged Move Picker
features.implementation: Phased move selector yielding TT move, good captures, killers, quiet moves, and losing captures on demand.

features.label: History & Killer Ordering
features.implementation: Butterfly quiet history table alongside two killers per ply and SEE capture filtering.

features.label: Transposition Table
features.implementation: Zobrist-indexed hash table caching search bounds, depths, and best moves.

features.label: King Zone Attack
features.implementation: Weighted minor and major piece attacks against the opponent's king zone.

features.label: Rook File Patterns
features.implementation: Bonuses for rooks on open, semi-open, and opponent-queen files.

features.label: Piece Mobility & Pawns
features.implementation: Piece mobility, pawn structure terms, and specialized endgame evaluators.

features.label: Tapered Eval
features.implementation: Packed middlegame/endgame score pairs interpolated by remaining game phase.
